summary: The filing reports the sponsor's entry into a benchmark licensing agreement with FTSE International Limited, replacing the prior CF Benchmarks index for the 21Shares Sui Staking ETF. The trust will value its shares using the FTSE Sui Index beginning August 27, 2026. Separately, the sponsor agreement was amended to change the sponsor fee payment timing from weekly to at least quarterly, payable in SUI. These are routine operational and index-provider changes for a crypto ETF, not a special-situation corporate event. No M&A, restructuring, or strategic transaction is involved.
